name: sampler4
title: Flexure sampler 4: travel stops, a curved leaf, a contact-aided leaf, a parallelogram and tweezers
orientation: Flat on the bed as drawn: everything bends in the plane of the bed, within its layers. 100% infill, 0.2 mm layers.

height.rule: Every part's width, up from the bed: 40 layers

rail.rule: The rail the parts stand off, along y

spacing.rule: From one part to the next along the rail

overlap.rule: How far a part sits into the rail, so they join

strain_limit.rule: The strain the stops are placed for: 2%, the working guess for PLA until the first samplers are measured

stop_factor.rule: The travel stops allow, as a share of the travel at the strain limit

stop_post.rule: The stop posts and bars across

stop_reach.value: thin / 2 + stop_factor * 2 * length * length * strain_limit / (3 * thin) + stop_post / 2
stop_reach.rule: From the stopped leaf's centreline to a post's centre: the leaf's half-thickness, the travel the stop allows, half a post

contact_at.rule: The contact-aided leaf's stop bar reaches this far from the root

gap.rule: Between the contact-aided leaf and its stop bar at rest

link.rule: The parallelogram's links, hinge to hinge

bar.rule: The parallelogram's ground and coupler bars, and the tweezers' arms

spring.rule: The tweezers' spring, between the arms' roots

arm.rule: The tweezers' arms, spring to jaws

open.rule: The tweezers' jaws apart at rest

lift.rule: The tweezers' spring off the rail, on a post at its middle: room for the spring to bend

rise.rule: The pre-curved leaf's tip off its chord at rest
